output.proposed_rendering:
For I know that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayer and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, according to my eager expectation and hope that in nothing I will be put to shame. Instead, with all boldness, now as always, Christ will be magnified in my body, whether through life or through death.

For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain. But if I am to live in the flesh, this means fruitful work for me, and I do not know what I will choose. I am hard pressed between the two: I have the desire to depart and be with Christ, for that is far better, but to remain in the flesh is more necessary for your sake.

Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith, so that your reason for boasting in Christ Jesus may overflow because of me when I come to you again.
